thread:
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED - GPU capacity exhaustion (us-west-2) — autoscaler failing to provision, queue growing fast > 18k requests. Paging on-call. https://internal/alerts/1769504302 :rotating_light:
ben_oncall: paging - seeing 5xx spikes and throttles on hosted inference. customers report slow responses / timeouts. queues: gen-queue backlog ~18.4k, avg wait 14.2s, p95 latency 9.8s.
liz_support: multiple customer tickets flagged high error rates, starting to consolidate impact list.
ben_oncall: logs show repeated Xid errors and driver OOMs on several nodes, e.g. `NVRM: Xid 13, pid 1234` and `OutOfMemoryError: CachingAlloc failed`. Autoscaler attempts to add nodes but pools report "registration timeout".
raj_sre: grabbing node list now. suspect kernel/driver crash loop causing nodes to be marked NotReady and autoscaler hitting max surge limit.
carmen_eng: confirming - kube events: `RegisterNodeError: failed to register gpu-driver: handshake timeout` then `node-condition Ready=false`.
ben_oncall: immediate mitigations: 1) cordon affected GPU nodes 2) drain non-critical jobs 3) manually scale up a fallback smaller-GPU pool (if quota allows) 4) apply temporary rate-limiting to low-tier customers. who can take the manual scale?
raj_sre: I'm on it. checking quotas — gce project quota for GPUs at 80/100, autoscaler wanted to add 40 but hit project limit. will request quota bump but that's slow. For immediate: can we move traffic to dedicated reserved pool where we have spare capacity?
carmen_eng: we have ~4 reserved nodes in dedicated-pool-usw2 that can take short bursts. I'll flip routing rule to prefer dedicated for high-latency requests. need 2-3m to reroute.
liz_support: compiling impacted customers list. so far 12 orgs with >30% error rate. flagging enterprise customers for outreach.
ben_oncall: attempting to restart nvidia driver on flapping nodes to recover GPU capacity. command: ```for n in $(kubectl get nodes -l gpu=true -o name); do ssh $n 'sudo systemctl restart nvidia-driver && sudo dmesg | tail -n 50'; done```
monitoring-bot: Alert: GPU-driver Xid error rate increased 6x in last 5m. Autoscaler scale failures count: 7. Queue length trend +1200/s.
raj_sre: executed driver restart on 5 nodes — 3 came back Ready, 2 still show Xid errors and OOM on boot. cordoned the 2 bad nodes.
carmen_eng: routed 30% of traffic to dedicated-pool-usw2. initial throughput drop but queue growth slowed.
ben_oncall: added manual scaler — increased pool max to 120 (temporary) but autoscaler still refuses due to quota. manual GCE create for 4 instances queued.
opsgenie: ben_oncall acknowledged the page at 12:18 UTC.
raj_sre: identified kernel module mismatch on the 2 failing nodes — recent driver rollout had a wrong kernel build. rolling back driver package on those hosts. ```apt-get install nvidia-driver-520=520.56.06-1 -y && reboot```
carmen_eng: rolling back rollout group for driver-v2.1 to previous stable; pausing further driver rollouts.
liz_support: outreach draft: "We are aware of elevated errors for inference requests in us-west-2. Engineers are mitigating. We will follow up with timeframe and any data reprocessing actions." who signs?
ben_oncall: send initial note as "Redwood Inference Status" and tag account managers. I'll include temporary mitigation steps and that we routed traffic to dedicated pool.
monitoring-bot: Queue length plateaued at 9k after routing change. p95 latency dropping to 4.2s. Error rate down 45% from peak.
ben_oncall: on-call handoff — I'm pausing active ops in 25m. raj_sre will take lead after 12:40 UTC. raj, confirm acceptance.
raj_sre: taking over incident at 12:40 UTC. I'll continue driver rollback and follow-up with a postmortem owner.
carmen_eng: action items: - rollback driver rollout (in progress) - disable auto driver rollout pipeline until postmortem - add pre-deploy kernel-driver matrix check - expand autoscaler logging for registration failures - create temporary rate-limits & quota dashboard for spikes
liz_support: updated customers with initial message, flagged top 3 enterprise accounts for 1:1 outreach.
ben_oncall: summary for handoff: cause = driver/runtime instability + autoscaler blocked by project GPU quota; symptom = queue growth & customer throttling; mitigations = driver rollback, route to dedicated pool, cordon/drain bad nodes, manual instance creations, temporary rate limits. Next steps: full postmortem, quota change request, rollout gating.
raj_sre: noted. assigning postmortem owner: carmen_eng. ETA initial draft 48h.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied, severity reduced to P2. Monitoring will keep 1h high-frequency check.
ben_oncall: thanks team. leaving the channel for handoff. :white_check_mark:
